assertions.assertion: Program.cs registers CustomClaimsPrincipalFactory as IUserClaimsPrincipalFactory<ApplicationUser> BEFORE calling AddAspNetIdentity
assertions.rationale: AddScoped<IUserClaimsPrincipalFactory<ApplicationUser>, CustomClaimsPrincipalFactory>() is registered before the AddAspNetIdentity call.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddAspNetIdentity<ApplicationUser>() which will wrap and call through to the custom factory
assertions.rationale: The AddIdentityServer() chain includes .AddAspNetIdentity<ApplicationUser>() and the text notes it wraps the registered factory.

assertions.assertion: A CustomProfileService class inherits from ProfileService<ApplicationUser> and overrides IsUserActiveAsync
assertions.rationale: CustomProfileService implements IProfileService directly rather than inheriting ProfileService<ApplicationUser>, and it never overrides IsUserActiveAsync.

assertions.assertion: The IsUserActiveAsync override checks a property on the user (e.g., user.IsEnabled or user.IsActive) to determine if the user is active
assertions.rationale: There is no IsUserActiveAsync override; the property check lives in an IProfileService.IsActiveAsync implementation instead of the specified override.

assertions.assertion: The CustomProfileService is registered in DI as the IProfileService implementation
assertions.rationale: builder.Services.AddTransient<IProfileService, CustomProfileService>() registers it as the IProfileService implementation.
